ShortDescription.Value: Experimental local fork of Placemaker with simplified Chinese localization.

Publish.LongDescription: citymaker is an experimental Cities: Skylines II mod derived from Placemaker by jackwrichards. Includes code originating in Parking Lot Tool (KruemelGames), ParkManager (tomkpunkt), and Grid Road Generator (Ti4goc). GPL-3.0; bundled Harmony is MIT. Development builds are intended for local testing.
